name: FREE GAME PERCENTAGE
meaning: FREE GAME PERCENTAGE = TOTAL FREE PLAYS x 100 / paid plays (counter 17)

name: AVERAGE BALL TIME
meaning: AVERAGE BALL TIME (s) = ball time counter 63 / TOTAL BALLS PLAYED (counter 8)

name: AVERAGE GAME TIME
meaning: AVERAGE GAME TIME (s) = game time counter 60 / TOTAL PLAYS

name: TOTAL COINS
meaning: TOTAL COINS = sum of the five slot counters

name: TOTAL EARNINGS
display_format: money: value x unit_value(current pricing) -> fmt msg at pricing record +0x16 (e.g. "USD %,d.%02d")
formula: c7  (shown as money: c7 x unit value of the CURRENT pricing, 64-bit, /100 and %100, money format +0x16)
meaning: TOTAL EARNINGS = units counter 7 converted with the pricing selected now (formatter 0x2e62c)

name: EXTRA BALL PERCENTAGE
meaning: EXTRA BALL PERCENTAGE = extra balls (counter 9) x 100 / paid plays

name: TOTAL FREE PLAYS
meaning: TOTAL FREE PLAYS = replays + specials + matches + high score awards

name: TOTAL PLAYS
meaning: TOTAL PLAYS = counter 17 (paid starts) + counter 18 (free starts)

name: AVERAGE SCORES
formula: (score_sum_u64 / score_count) / 10 * 10, low 32 bits; 0 when the record at NVRAM 0x21109d4 fails its checksum or count = 0
meaning: AVERAGE SCORES from NVRAM 0x21109d4 {u64 sum, u32 count, ~checksum16}

name: CENTER DRAINS
meaning: CENTER DRAINS = balls played - left drains - right drains

name: RECENT REPLAY PERCENT
meaning: RECENT REPLAY PERCENT: always 0% in v1.74
